records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Net sales for the three months ended June 30, 2021 decreased by 2% to $629.2 million compared to $642.4 million for the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was primarily driven by the sale of the American Kings project in the prior period and the completion of substantially all construction activities at the GA Solar 4 project in 2020, partially offset by an increase in the volume of modules sold to third parties and the settlement of an outstanding indemnification arrangement associated with the sale of one of our projects.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Gross profit for the three months ended June 30, 2021 increased 6.3 percentage points to 27.7% from 21.4% for the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In particular, module average selling prices in many global markets have declined over several years.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by the $350 million settlement payment associated with our prior class action lawsuit in 2020 and the timing of cash receipts from certain third-party module sales in the prior period, for which proceeds were received in late 2019 prior to the step down in the U.S. investment tax credit, partially offset by lower cash proceeds from the sales of systems projects in the current period.
